blocks.text: COTABATO CITY—Officials of Moro Islamic Liberation Front (MILF) clarified that there are no ongoing authorized recruitment activities in the name of the Bangsamoro Islamic Armed Forces (BIAF). They said that such events are not held without the approval of the MILF’s central committee. In a statement Friday, Nov. 13, MILF chairman Ahod Balawag Ebrahim made it known that there is only one MILF, with a recognized leadership, organizational structure, and clear chain of command. He is also concurrently the chief of its military arm, the BIAF. “No individual or group has the authority to claim to represent the MILF or conduct […]...
